correctness.rationale: Corollary 4.3 supplies a one-dimensional two-sided ideal annihilated on both sides. Induction in the quotient and pullback gives a complete flag with multiplication lowering the flag by one step, hence \(A^{n+1}=0\). Lemma 2.2 is homogeneous with factors of original degree \(1\) or \(3\), so any degree \(d\) term has at least \(\lceil d/3\rceil\) left-normed factors; \(d\ge 3n+1\) therefore forces at least \(n+1\) factors and vanishes. Hypotheses and conventions match the source.
